pkgmetadata.longdescription:
The pve-rs workspace from the proxmox-perl-rs repository. Compiles Rust code into a cdylib (libpve_rs.so) and generates Perl wrapper modules via perlmod-bin's genpackage.pl.
Provides the following Perl packages used by the pxvirt management stack at runtime: - Proxmox::Lib::PVE — shared library loader - PVE::RS::APT::Repositories — APT repo management (stubbed on Gentoo) - PVE::RS::Firewall::SDN — SDN firewall support - PVE::RS::OpenId — OIDC authentication - PVE::RS::ResourceScheduling::Static — HA resource scheduling - PVE::RS::TFA — Two-factor authentication
Gentoo-specific changes: - proxmox-apt "cache" feature removed (no libapt-pkg on Gentoo) - APT cache XS exports stubbed to return errors at runtime - Vendor tarball includes Proxmox monorepo crates (April 2025 snapshot) and perlmod 0.13.6 from the pxvirt perlmod submodule
